value.rationale: For a natural two-value noisy sensor budget, optimal locations are crucial and exact all-noise rules save sensor-design search. The unexpected exact h_M=h_G^2 relation reveals how prior smoothness changes resolution scaling from eta^{1/3} to eta^{1/6}, while exact posterior Bayes risks quantify consequences. The theorem includes proof of global uniqueness within the explicit symmetric design class, not an arbitrary finite parameter table.
